integrity: General proof supplied with a separate finite verifier; the full result has not received independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact enumeration assumes at least two positive clique blades meeting at one hub and palette size equal to the chromatic number. It is not a general block-graph or larger-palette theorem. Finite checks do not prove the infinite family; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact forced-colouring polynomial of heterogeneous clique bouquets
